My first visit wasn't perfect, but the doctor was very responsible. I reported the problems after the procedure, and the doctor fixed it the very next day, even though it was a holiday. The doctor was very patient, and the assistants were very kind and lovely. My 4-year-old was suffering from severe tooth pain, and they helped to hold the doctor down without getting annoyed. I was very impressed. Thank you so much. They even let us come late at night, so my child didn't have to endure the pain. ☺️

I want to thank the woman who stroked my hand while I was lying on the bed in excruciating pain and fear. It was like she was reassuring me that I was safe. It was an experience I never want to repeat. Patients want good, reassuring, and comfortable service. Please consider today's case and whether it was truly appropriate.

The medical assistant service was the worst I've ever experienced at a dental clinic. They were unwilling to help. The prices are high, but the service is terrible. Only the staff at the counter were good; they spoke as if they were well-trained, a stark contrast to the medical assistant. The doctor was indifferent; I have no opinion. I will definitely not be going back here again. One time wasted money, and that's it. The prices weren't even cheap.

I'm not sure if it's the same owner as the one that used to be in Hua Hin.

We treated a cavity in my daughter's baby tooth. It was hurting, and there was a large hole. They treated it very quickly and efficiently; I didn't even need painkillers! There aren't many pediatric dentists in Hua Hin, and there are huge queues everywhere. This clinic had an appointment booked for the next few days. We were afraid to go because of the reviews, but it turned out to be for nothing. I highly recommend it!
The service was excellent. I'm very impressed.💖 …

The patient had gingivitis, bleeding gums, and toothache. The dentist said there were three cavities and one impacted tooth. They offered either fillings (all three) or extracting the impacted tooth, at 900 baht per filling. The patient essentially said, "If they can't treat it, they should just charge for the consultation." They were willing to pay. Ultimately, they had one tooth filled for 900 baht. However, the gingivitis didn't improve, and they had to resort to medication at a pharmacy.
